referee_caveats_inferred: The paper does not give a formal likelihood or posterior uncertainty analysis; the gas-mass interval is a systematic assessment.
Integrated-mass agreement does not establish unique radial surface densities.
The drift test fixes the drift radius to the observed edge, so it establishes consistency rather than an independent prediction of that edge.
The SI conclusion depends strongly on adopted opacity, settling, turbulence and the applicable threshold.
The supplied parameter tables lose a_max and q, preventing exact reconstruction from this text.
Distance and dust-edge values differ across sections and need reconciliation.
